body_html:
@cathieleblanc Thanks for the #indieweb WordPress user interview. Your experiences will help us better shape the onboarding process for new users.

You can see a summary of our interview here. Feel free to change or ask me to change anything: https://indieweb.org/WordPress/Onboarding

I look forward to following your work. If you want to see how others built microblogging feeds into their wordpress check out @chrisaldrich and @gwg
